chapter.title: Act V: Second Spring
subtitle: Second Spring, Year Two
Re-found the town: finish the square, balance the books, and sink the quarry that pays for the next hundred years.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

quests.title: Sleep One Night, Then Walk the Square With Marnie
quests.subtitle: Year two.
description: Marnie: "You slept clean through the thaw. Come on — the square's still standing and I want you to see it in daylight."
Sleep one night in your own bed after the Longest Night, then walk the square with Marnie.
Opens year two: Nella's cold frame, Oda's counter, and the thirty tiles of the square. The dressing packet for those tiles is in this quest's rewards.

tasks.title: Slept one night after the Longest Night, then walked the square with Marnie

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"The noticeboard's rewritten. Year two, and it's a longer list than last spring.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Year two
rewards.description: Next: glaze Nella's cold frame with 16 Greenhouse Glass.

quests.title: Glaze the Cold Frame and Grow Four Crops Out of Season
quests.subtitle: Nella's chain closes.
description: Nella: "Glass in February, and I grew a tomato. I'm not making a speech about it."

Glaze Nella's cold frame with 16 Greenhouse Glass — the recipe went live when the coolant loop reached the heaters — then grow and hold one Tomato, one Strawberry, one Bell Pepper and one Corn at the same time.
Nella takes the gardener's job and her chain closes. Marnie eats the first tomato standing in the doorway and says nothing about it.

tasks.title: Cold frame glazed with 16 Greenhouse Glass

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Nella: ","color":"aqua"},{"text":"I'll take the gardener's job. Don't tell Pip, he'll shout.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Nella's chain closes
rewards.description: Next: the derby — six fish for the inn wall.

quests.title: Put One Item on Each of the 30 Marked Copper Tiles
quests.subtitle: Any order is right.
description: Oda: "Thirty tiles, thirty things. I have a preferred order — ignore me."
Place one item on each of the 30 marked copper tiles in the square. Everything came in Marnie's packet: 8 Flower Boxes, 8 Candle Holders, 6 Lanterns, 4 Oak Benches, 4 Planters. Any order is right.
Oda's full catalogue goes free at her counter, and the square is finished.

tasks.title: All 30 marked copper tiles in the square have something on them

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Catalogue's free to you from today. I'll still have opinions.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The square is finished
rewards.description: Next: the bell post is the only bare thing left. Cook eight dinners first.

quests.title: Catch Six Named Fish and Hang Three Mounts on the Inn Wall
quests.subtitle: The Fishing Derby.
description: Nella: "Six for the wall. Trout and pike sit in the cold water off the pier; the rest are anywhere."

Catch one Bluegill, one Perch, one Brown Trout, one Muskellunge (that's the pike), one Catfish and one Carp — worm bait for the catfish and carp — then craft 3 Oak Fish Mounts and hang three of them on the inn wall.
Pays 50 Valley Scrip toward the town's winter debt.

rewards.title: Six on the wall
rewards.description: Next: cook the eight dinners, then 120 Scrip at Oda's counter clears the winter debt.

quests.title: Hit 25,000 FE/t on a Second Turbine Without Passing 60 mB/t of Fuel
quests.subtitle: A problem, not a recipe.
description: Tobin: "Second turbine, same reactor, and the fuel line does not move. I did the arithmetic four times, then once more with Bram watching."

Build a second turbine off the reactor and hold 25,000 FE/t across both, with fuel burn at 60 mB/t or under. Tobin's signed figures are the journal page from his safety check. Run /valley check power at the reactor terminal — it prints both numbers and ticks this quest.
Stage big_power. The quarry runs off this and nothing else does.

tasks.title: 25,000 FE/t sustained across both turbines at 60 mB/t fuel burn or under (/valley check power)

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Twenty-five thousand, and the fuel line never moved. That's the town through next winter twice over.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Stage: big_power
rewards.description: Next: two Crafting CPUs and wireless across the whole town.

quests.title: Hold 2 16k Crafting Storage, 2 Access Points and 4 Wireless Boosters
quests.subtitle: Everything, everywhere.
description: Bram: "Wireless, in my mill. Fine."
Build the network out: hold 2 16k Crafting Storage, 2 ME Wireless Access Points and 4 Wireless Boosters.
Every player gets a wireless terminal, an export subnet keeps Marnie's pantry stocked, and the Delivery Crate fills itself for the eight dinners.

rewards.title: The town is on the network
rewards.description: Next: eight dinners, ingredients already in the Delivery Crate.

quests.title: Cook and Deliver Each Resident's Favourite Dish
quests.subtitle: Eight plates, eight people.
description: Marnie: "Eight plates, eight people. The crate by the counter already has every ingredient in it — your network saw to that."

Cook and hand over one of each: Roast Chicken for Marnie, Beef Stew for Bram, Cabbage Rolls for Oda, Fish Stew for Nella, Mushroom Rice for Halden, Bacon and Eggs for Tobin, Fruit Salad for Wisp, Sweet Berry Cheesecake for Pip.
You keep the Feast Crate: one of each, set aside for Founder's Day.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"You cooked for eight people who all showed up. Josie managed that twice.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Feast Crate stored
rewards.description: Next: the boat. The compass in this payout is already set to the Cairn Chapel and the Drowned Lighthouse.

quests.title: Sail to the Cairn Chapel and the Drowned Lighthouse
quests.subtitle: Out past the ridge.
description: Pip: "The chapel's called the Cairn and the lighthouse is called Drowned and I named the boat Biscuit!"

Take the boat out with Nella and Pip, following the Explorer's Compass from the last payout to the Cairn Chapel and then the Drowned Lighthouse. A waystone stands at each and the chest is under the beacon beam. Bring back the Cross Necklace from the chapel and the Snorkel from the lighthouse.
You keep the Warding Lamp — you'll want it in the cave under the Works.

rewards.title: Two names on the map
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's lanterns, down under the Works.

quests.title: Follow Tobin's Lanterns Down and Bring Back 1 Echo Shard
quests.subtitle: Deeper and darker.
description: Tobin: "Dead sculk, no Warden — I checked twice, then again with a stick. Mind the third lantern, it hangs crooked."
Follow Tobin's lantern line down into the echo cave under the Works and bring back 1 Echo Shard. The Warding Lamp from the boat trip holds the dark off the whole chamber.
The deep survey data is what sites the quarry.

tasks.title: Reached the echo cave under the Works

quests.title: Pay 120 Valley Scrip at Oda's Counter
quests.subtitle: Oda's chain closes.
description: Oda: "Eleven years, and here — you hold the ledger. I've held it long enough."
Hand 120 Valley Scrip across Oda's counter to clear the town's winter debt.
The books balance for the first time since Josie. Oda's chain closes and 25 Scrip comes straight back to you.

rewards.title: The books balance
rewards.description: Next: 80 Scrip and Standing: Trusted buys the Works Deed.

quests.title: Buy the Works Deed: 80 Valley Scrip and Standing: Trusted
quests.subtitle: Six of eight chains closed.
description: Halden: "Josie meant the Works to belong to whoever stayed. Nobody has argued about it in four years."
Pay 80 Valley Scrip at Oda's counter, and close six of the eight resident chains — the checkmark ticks itself the moment Standing: Trusted comes through.
The Deed is yours: QuarryPlus becomes craftable, the residents vote, and Bram signs as witness.

tasks.title: Standing: Trusted — six of the eight resident chains closed

rewards.command: /tellraw @a {"text":"The residents vote. Bram signs as witness: 'Kettle Works. Town-held. Good.'","color":"gold"}

rewards.title: The Works Deed
rewards.description: Next: place the quarry on Tobin's site and power it.

quests.title: Place the Quarry and 4 Markers on Tobin's Site and Power It
quests.subtitle: Tobin's arc closes.
description: Tobin: "Rig on my X, markers on the four corners, power off the reactor. I am extremely calm about this."
Hold the QuarryPlus Quarry and 4 Markers, set them on the site the deep survey picked, and run power to the rig from the reactor.
The shaft sinks and the quarry runs. It is the biggest thing Tobin has ever been responsible for, and his arc closes here.

tasks.title: Quarry placed on the surveyed site and powered from the reactor

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Right. That's a town works, and I'm going to go and sit down.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Tobin's arc closes
rewards.description: Next: 1,024 cobblestone from network stock to the granary.

quests.title: Deliver 1,024 Cobblestone From Network Stock to the Granary
quests.subtitle: The first load.
description: Bram: "Rock into the box, box into the granary. That's a public works, not a hole in a hill."
Route the quarry's output into the ME network, then deliver 1,024 cobblestone out of network stock to the granary. One bounded cycle — the quarry keeps running afterwards.
Stage town_provides: Oda's shelves restock themselves from your network from now on, permanently.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"My shelves filled themselves overnight. I have written it in the ledger and I am watching it.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Stage: town_provides
rewards.description: Next: cast a bell from the quarry's own copper.

quests.title: Cast 1 Bell From Quarry Copper and Hang It on the Marked Post
quests.subtitle: Pip's arc closes.
description: Pip: "I get to ring it, and I already named it! It's called Big Copper!"
Cast 1 Bell from the quarry's own copper and hang it on the marked post in the finished square.
Every resident comes out for it. Pip is the bell-ringer from today, and his arc closes.

tasks.title: Bell hung on the marked post in the square

rewards.command: /tellraw @a {"text":"Pip rings it eleven times. Nobody stops him.","color":"gold","italic":true}

rewards.title: The bell is up
rewards.description: Next: the fortieth lamp, on the bare post at Josie's porch.

quests.title: Put the Fortieth Lamp on the Bare Post at Josie's Porch
quests.subtitle: The last lamp.
description: Josie, in the journal: "Leave one post bare. Somebody will want it later."
Walk up to Josie's porch and place the fortieth lamp on the bare post — the only one on the whole road that never got lit.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

tasks.title: Fortieth lamp placed on the bare post at Josie's porch

rewards.command: /tellraw @a {"text":"Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.","color":"gold","italic":true}
/tellraw @p {"text":"Journal Entry 5 has been added to Josie's Journal — the last thing she wrote.","color":"gray"}

rewards.title: Lamps 40/40
rewards.description: Next: set the eight dishes on the long table and light the Hearth.

quests.title: Set the Eight Feast Dishes on the Long Table and Light the Hearth
quests.subtitle: Act V finale — Founder's Day.
description: Marnie: "Bring the crate. Everyone's already here — I have never once had to set this many chairs."
Take the eight dishes out of the Feast Crate, set them on the long table in the inn, and light the Hearth.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
Founder's Day. Sit down — you live here.

rewards.title: Founder's Day
rewards.description: Next: Endless Seasons — festivals, bounties and new arrivals. The story ends. The world doesn't.
